verdict.rationale: The SOS site has a dedicated business-entities forms page on the public sos.ca.gov domain. It says all business forms can be submitted by mail or in person, which implies paper forms are published there, and it notes over 140 filings are available online. The User Access requirement applies to online Statement of Information filing, not to obtaining forms. missing for 10: an explicit statement that form PDFs are downloadable without an account, evidence that accompanying instructions are published, and hands-on confirmation of account-free download.
